q: What separates an agent from a workflow?
options: In an agent the model decides the next step; in a workflow code decides it
Agents always run in the cloud
explain: The useful line is control: who chooses the next step.

q: Which task is the best fit for a workflow rather than an agent?
options: Researching an open question across the web
Extracting the same five fields from every invoice
Handling a support request that mixes several problems
explain: Known, repeatable steps belong in code.

q: Why did coding become the first domain where agents paid off?
options: Tests give the loop an honest feedback signal
explain: Running tests tells the agent whether it succeeded, so it can iterate toward a verifiable goal.
